terms.quote: Licence (A1, legal floor): feed terms are 'unknown' until legal reviews them, so nothing runs yet in any profile. Legal's feed-reader decision (poll <= hourly; headline + link + date only; no full text; no redistribution) is recorded per kept feed with its class and evidence; a feed whose terms forbid business use or automated reading is dropped.

rss.notes: Quote: binding council text (P298 cond 3). Feed https://www.darkreading.com/rss_simple.asp; read by module cti_news_rss through the dataset manager (TTL 3600 s, conditional GET, 2 MiB cap, <= 200 items; headline + link + date only, descriptions discarded). Live 2026-11-25/26 from the datacenter egress: 403 Cloudflare managed challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge). Never bypassed (rule 1, A9): the curated feed list marks it blocked and the module does not fetch it until the team network re-verifies it; meanwhile it is a manual link.
